notes.title: Fix Update Released
notes.content:
We recently announced that there will be an update to the game. Many of you reported problems about save-load structure of the game. There is also problem with sticking on certain place in the game. It did not let the players continue.
The update fixes save-load problem. The players can save throughout the game and can load the save file and carry on the last point they left. Moreover, it is no more an issue to hold on a level and be unable to continue. Now, you can continue playing and enjoy the game.

Thank you very much for your feedback and continuous support.
Missed Approach Interactive

notes.title: Upcoming When She's Gone Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178214/4123de59851e97531db8f2447d925304a2625b04.png

When She's Gone set sail on September 16th and it shows a quite promise. We hope you like what you have experienced so far.

On the other hand, there are problems with the game. We are announcing an update to the game, hopefully solves the issues.

Many players struggle to save and load the game. The update mainly focuses on save/load structure. With the fix, players will be able to multiple save and automatic load the latest save file.
At some point, the game does not progress as it is supposed to be, and affects the narrative, yet more importantly, affects the gameplay. The fix will solve resolution inconsistencies (for FHD and higher resolutions) and progression related issues.

Thank you for your support and patience. We are trying to give the best you deserve.
Missed Approach Interactive
